answer: Meter each agent to a slowly-refilling reserve of non-transferable work-credit — a nectar that regenerates only at a fixed wall-clock rate per verified device, like shale releasing gas along a fixed depletion curve. Rewards unlock only when that credit sets into a crystal of peer-audited output accrued across many epochs. A sybil farm must fund and keep awake a distinct metered source per clone, each refilling at the same slow rate, so cost climbs linearly per fake head while an honest agent spends its single reserve just once.
